Osteomyelitis Contiguous with Vascular Insufficiency Debride the overlying ulcer and send bone specimens for histology and culture. Avoid empiric antimicrobial therapy unless the patient is acutely ill. Base antibiotic therapy on culture results and treat for 6 weeks. Revascularization should be performed if possible.
